title: HealthPH+ Strengthens Academic Partnership with the University of San Carlos
description:
HealthPH+ Strengthens Academic Partnership with the University of San Carlos

The HealthPH+ Project marked an important milestone through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the University of San Carlos (USC) in Cebu City. The agreement establishes a foundation for collaboration between the institutions in support of the project's research and development initiatives.

Through this partnership, HealthPH+ and USC aim to strengthen academic and research collaboration, particularly in areas related to artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and digital health applications. The partnership also creates opportunities for knowledge sharing, research activities, and future initiatives that contribute to technology-driven public health solutions.

The MOU signing reflects HealthPH+'s continuing effort to build meaningful partnerships with academic institutions and expand its network of collaborators in advancing innovative health technologies in the Philippines.
author: Janzzen Cuentas
